name: Melakat
description: Research-first digital evolution simulator with headless experiment and scientific evidence interfaces.

capabilities.name: status
capabilities.description: Inspect the configured Melakat project and experiment interface.

capabilities.name: validateExperiment
capabilities.description: Validate a Melakat experiment specification through the repository CLI.

capabilities.name: runExperiment
capabilities.description: Run a controlled Melakat experiment campaign and require passing validation evidence.

capabilities.name: readCampaign
capabilities.description: Read the canonical Melakat campaign artifact.

capabilities.name: readValidation
capabilities.description: Read and evaluate the canonical Melakat validation artifact.

capabilities.name: compareConditions
capabilities.description: Read baseline, condition, and comparison evidence from Melakat summary artifacts.

capabilities.name: evidenceSummary
capabilities.description: Build a compact evidence/checksum summary from canonical Melakat artifacts.

capabilities.name: findExtinctions
capabilities.description: Identify runs whose recorded final active population is zero without inferring cause.

capabilities.name: findAnomalies
capabilities.description: Identify canonical experimental-integrity inspection candidates without biological interpretation.
